title: limonium gallicum
intro: Limonium gallicum, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Statice, is a perennial coastal plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Limonium gallicum include its antimicrobial and antispasmodic properties, which can aid in wound healing and muscle relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, particularly limonene and geraniol, which contribute to its therapeutic potential.
